Evidence: docs/pr-evidence/pr204-localization-2026-11-02/window-963-982/.

The source and translation changes align with the component’s browser-local disabled-authority selection state.

The 36 holds remain for positions 970, 971, and 980 because no exact production callers were found. Qualified native-speaker approval, current-head browser review, and broader responsive/RTL review remain outstanding. No tests, builds, scans, or CI were run; no workflow edits, merge, release, or tag occurred.
